---
title: "Journal Articles"
format: html
page-layout: full

---

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

library(bibtex)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)
library(lubridate)

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a) && length(a) > 0) a else b

bib <- bibtex::read.bib("references.bib")

parse_pub_date <- function(x) {
  # 1) if full date exists (BibLaTeX style)
  if (!is.null(x$date)) {
    d <- suppressWarnings(ymd(x$date))
    if (!is.na(d)) return(d)
  }
  
  # 2) otherwise use year + month (BibTeX style)
  yr <- x$year %||% NA
  mo <- x$month %||% 1  # default January if missing
  
  # Month can be "jun", "June", "6", etc.
  mo_num <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(mo))
  if (is.na(mo_num)) {
    mo_num <- match(tolower(substr(as.character(mo), 1, 3)),
                    tolower(month.abb))
  }
  if (is.na(mo_num)) mo_num <- 1
  
  # Build a date using first day of month
  suppressWarnings(ymd(paste0(yr, "-", mo_num, "-01")))
}


fmt_authors <- function(a) {
  if (is.null(a)) return(NA_character_)
  out <- tryCatch(
    bibtex::format.author(a),
    error = function(e) a
  )
  # collapse anything vector-like into 1 string
  paste(out, collapse = "; ")
}

articles <- tibble(
  key      = names(bib),
  title    = sapply(bib, function(x) x$title %||% NA),
  year     = as.integer(sapply(bib, function(x) x$year %||% NA)),
  month    = sapply(bib, function(x) x$month %||% NA),  # optional to keep
  pub_date = sapply(bib, parse_pub_date),
  journal  = sapply(bib, function(x) x$journal %||% x$journaltitle %||% NA),
  authors  = sapply(bib, function(x) fmt_authors(x$author)),
  doi      = sapply(bib, function(x) x$doi %||% NA),
  url      = sapply(bib, function(x) {
    x$url %||% (if (!is.null(x$doi)) paste0("https://doi.org/", x$doi) else NA)
  })
) %>%
  arrange(desc(pub_date), journal, title)


reactable(
  # Include pub_date FIRST so we can sort by it (even though it's hidden)
  articles %>% select(title, pub_date, year, journal, authors, url),
  
  searchable = TRUE,        # global keyword search bar
  filterable = TRUE,        # enables column filters you specify
  defaultPageSize = 20,
  highlight = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,
  bordered = FALSE,
  wrap = TRUE,

  # ⭐ Sort newest → oldest by actual publication date
  defaultSorted = list(pub_date = "desc"),

  columns = list(

    # Hidden sort column
    pub_date = colDef(
      show = FALSE           # we use it for ordering but don’t display it
    ),

    title = colDef(
      name = "Title",
      minWidth = 320,
      filterable = FALSE,
      cell = function(value) div(style = "white-space: normal;", value)
    ),

    year = colDef(
      name = "Year",
      sortable = TRUE,
      filterable = TRUE,
      filterInput = function(values, name) {
        years <- sort(unique(values), decreasing = TRUE)
        htmltools::tags$select(
          onchange = sprintf("Reactable.setFilter('%s', this.value)", name),
          htmltools::tags$option(value = "", "All years"),
          lapply(years, function(y) htmltools::tags$option(value = y, y))
        )
      },
      width = 90
    ),

    journal = colDef(
      name = "Journal",
      sortable = TRUE,
      filterable = TRUE,
      filterInput = function(values, name) {
        journals <- sort(unique(values))
        htmltools::tags$select(
          onchange = sprintf("Reactable.setFilter('%s', this.value)", name),
          htmltools::tags$option(value = "", "All journals"),
          lapply(journals, function(j) htmltools::tags$option(value = j, j))
        )
      },
      minWidth = 180
    ),

    authors = colDef(
      name = "Authors",
      filterable = FALSE,
      minWidth = 220,
      cell = function(value) div(style = "white-space: normal;", value)
    ),

    url = colDef(
      name = "Link",
      filterable = FALSE,
      width = 110,
      cell = function(value) {
        if (is.na(value)) return("")
        a(href = value, "doi/link", target = "_blank")
      }
    )
  )
)


```
